desc_en: A clean, matched-camera transformation of one Skopje Old Bazaar salon corner—same hero stylist, same room, same angle at start and end—showing a step-by-step refresh that feels real, local, and premium without stock clichés.
music: Warm modern Balkan downtempo with light percussion, 92 bpm, building subtly to a bright final hit
vo_mk: Нежна нега, подготвена за секој ден.
Нов изглед, истиот наш мирис на дом.

shots.kf: Interior of a small Skopje Old Bazaar beauty salon corner, early morning. One female stylist (late 20s, dark bob hair, beige knit sweater, black apron) stands beside a tired wash station: dull off-white tiles, slightly scuffed beige cabinet, fogged mirror, tangled cords. Framing is locked-off wide from doorway height, 24mm lens. Cool daylight from one side window, muted cream and grey palette. No readable text anywhere.
shots.motion: She opens the cabinet and pulls out a folded microfiber cloth while the camera makes a slow, straight dolly-in about 40 cm, keeping the wash station centered and the frame perfectly level.
shots.end_kf: Same locked-off wide angle inside the Skopje Old Bazaar salon corner, early morning. The same stylist in identical clothes stands by the same wash station, now visibly prepped: cords coiled neatly, mirror wiped clear, counter cleared, cabinet front clean. The tiles remain the same but look brighter from cleanliness. 24mm lens, cool daylight, cream and grey palette. No readable text anywhere.

shots.kf: Close medium shot of the same wash station countertop and sink edge, hands prominent and simple. The stylist’s beige sleeve and black apron are visible as she uses a spray bottle with plain, unbranded design. Water spots, smudges and scattered cotton pads sit on the surface. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. Soft side daylight, neutral tones with a hint of warm skin color. No logos, no readable labels.
shots.motion: She sprays the surface and wipes in one continuous circular pass; the camera performs a gentle slide left-to-right about 30 cm, maintaining focus on her hands and the changing sheen of the countertop.

shots.kf: Medium shot from the same salon corner, angled slightly toward a small open shelf beside the wash station. The stylist places a plain frosted-glass pump bottle (unlabeled) onto the shelf; nearby items are mismatched and scattered. 35mm lens, natural daylight mixed with a soft practical lamp glow, creating a realistic warm-cool balance. Palette: beige, off-white, matte black apron. No readable text, no signage.
shots.motion: She aligns three identical unlabeled bottles into a straight row with one decisive adjustment; the camera makes a slow tilt down and back up, ending with the shelf perfectly centered for a clean, orderly feel.

shots.kf: Tight close-up on the stylist’s hands and a client’s forearm resting on a clean towel near the same wash station. The stylist applies a small amount of product from the same unlabeled frosted pump bottle, rubbing it gently into the skin. 85mm lens, soft daylight, flattering but realistic texture. Color palette stays calm: creams, warm skin tones, matte black. Faces are not visible, no readable text.
shots.motion: She performs one smooth application stroke from wrist to mid-forearm; the camera does a slow micro push-in, about 15 cm, emphasizing the product sheen settling naturally on skin.

shots.kf: Locked-off wide shot from the exact same doorway angle as shot 1, showing the full salon corner before the final reveal. The stylist stands still beside the wash station; the area looks partially improved but not fully finished: a towel is folded unevenly, one cord still loose, lighting still slightly flat. 24mm lens, same morning daylight, neutral cream and grey palette. No readable text or logos anywhere.
shots.motion: She snaps one towel edge into a crisp fold and gently switches on a warm practical light; the camera repeats the same slow dolly-in as shot 1, matching speed and distance for a clear before-to-after comparison.
shots.end_kf: Same locked-off wide doorway shot, identical framing and lens. The same stylist stands in the same spot, calm and proud. The wash station corner is now fully finished: mirror crystal clear, cords hidden, towels neatly stacked, shelf perfectly aligned with the same unlabeled frosted bottles, warm practical light blending with daylight for a welcoming glow. Palette remains cream, beige, matte black accents. No readable text, no signage, no logos.
